$comment: Licence policy for third-party components (SPDX ids), shared by `pnpm licenses:check` (license-checker-rseidelsohn, reads `allowed` only) and the compliance checks in scripts/compliance (SBOM, Python, container images). `allowed`: accepted for every ecosystem. `separateServiceOnly`: copyleft, accepted only for container images / services flagged `separateService: true` in config/compliance/components.yaml, never inside the npm or Python dependency trees. `deny`: forbidden by AGENTS.md rule 6, never waivable. Anything else needs an entry in config/compliance/license-exceptions.yaml. Patterns are case-insensitive; a trailing * is a prefix glob. Add a licence to `allowed` only after reviewing it against AGENTS.md rule 6.
